description: handle_mdn_send checks CRLF on mdn_gateway and original_message_id (server-set fields shared with MDN/parse) but does NOT check original_recipient. The comment at lines 240-243 correctly identifies that server-set fields shared with the Mdn struct must be CRLF-checked if they can appear in generated RFC 5322 headers — but original_recipient was omitted. A client-supplied CRLF in originalRecipient would be passed to backend.send_mdns() unchecked; a backend that builds Original-Recipient: headers from this field would be vulnerable to header injection. Trigger: MDN/send with {"send": {"k1": {"forEmailId": "...", "originalRecipient": "foo\r\nX-Injected: bar", "disposition": {...}}}} — backend receives unchecked value.
title: Missing CRLF check on original_recipient in handle_mdn_send
